BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

  IN THE MATTER OF SOUTHWESTERN PUBLIC                             )
  SERVICE COMPANY’S APPLICATION FOR: (1)                           )
  REVISION OF ITS RETAIL RATES UNDER                               )   Docket 25-00079-UT
  ADVICE NOTICE 341; AND (2) OTHER                                 )
  ASSOCIATED RELIEF                                                )


                                ORDER EXTENDING DEADLINES

         THIS MATTER comes before the Hearing Examiners upon the Joint Motion to Extend

Rebuttal Testimony Deadline (“Joint Motion”) filed on May 22, 2026, by Southwestern Public

Service Company (“SPS”), New Mexico Large Customer Group (“NMLCG”), Occidental

Permian Ltd. (“OPL”), Louisiana Energy Services LLC (“LES”), Federal Executive Agencies

(“FEA”), Walmart Inc. (“Walmart”), Targa Resources Corp. (“Targa”), Coalition for Clean

Affordable Energy (“CCAE”), and Prosperity Works (collectively, the “Joint Movants”). Being

duly informed, the Hearing Examiners FIND and CONCLUDE:

         1.     The Joint Movants request an extension of the deadline for filing rebuttal testimony

 from May 29, 2026, to June 9, 2026. 1

         2.     As grounds, the Joint Motion states that “[t]he parties are now engaged in

 settlement discussions that may narrow or resolve issues that otherwise would require rebuttal or

 cross-rebuttal testimony,” and, “[a]llowing additional time for the parties to prepare and file

 rebuttal testimony would promote efficiency and conserve the resources of the parties, the Co-

 Hearing Examiners, and the Commission. If the parties reach a stipulation, some or all rebuttal

 testimony may become unnecessary.” 2




1 Joint Motion (May 22, 2026) ¶ 7.

2 Id. ¶¶ 4-5.
            BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
Order Extending Deadlines                            Docket No. 25-00079-UT



            3.       The Joint Motion is unopposed. 3

            4.       Having given due consideration to the Joint Motion and circumstances presented,

    the Hearing Examiners find good and sufficient cause to extend the rebuttal testimony deadline.

            5.       The Hearing Examiners therefore recognize the appropriateness of extending the

    deadlines for any motions in limine, motions to strike testimony, and other prehearing motions

    that may be filed with respect to testimony. The Hearing Examiners’ March 20, 2026, Order

    Setting Status Conference and Motion Deadlines previously established that any motions in

    limine, motions to strike testimony, and other prehearing motions shall be filed on or before June

    12, 2026, and that responses to such motions shall be filed on or before June 23, 2026. The

    Hearing Examiners now clarify that the deadlines shall apply only for motions with respect to

    testimony, and should be extended to June 18, 2026, and June 25, 2026, respectively.

IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

            A.       The Joint Motion is GRANTED.

            B.       The deadline for filing of rebuttal testimony is extended to June 9, 2026.

            C.       With respect to testimony, any motions in limine, motions to strike testimony, and

    other prehearing motions shall be filed on or before June 18, 2026. Responses to such motions

    shall be filed on or before June 25, 2026.




3
    See Id. at 1, ¶ 8.

                                                     -2-
            BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
Order Extending Deadlines                            Docket No. 25-00079-UT



     ISSUED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, on May 27, 2026.
